notes.title: Hitting trending wishlists section!
notes.content:
Oh wow, what a weekend!

Thank you, everyone, for the great reception and all the love you've shown us. We will work hard to make sure we deliver what we promise.

We still have a lot to learn about how Steam works. What leaves me wondering now is that I see a lot of people coming to see our game from the Trending Wishlist Section, with a hint that it's "a section showing games that have a recent upward trend in the volume of users wishlisting the game."

First of all, I am never tired of thanking everyone who got interested in what we've shown!

Second, does anyone know where this section is shown? I've never seen one in my Steam interface xD
